1101:
Information on the available recovery
                            management commands.
1104:
Shows the current status of Recovery
                            Remote Management Plugins (RRMPs).
1105:
/Get-RemoteManagementStatus 

  Displays whether Recovery Remote Management Plugins (RRMPs) 
  are currently enabled or disabled. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Get-RemoteManagementStatus
1107:
Enables or disables Recovery Remote
                            Management Plugins (RRMPs).
1108:
/Set-RemoteManagementStatus /Status:{Enable|Disable} 

  Enables or disables the use of Recovery Remote Management 
  Plugins (RRMPs) by the System Recovery Tools (SRT). 

  /Status                - Enable or Disable. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Set-RemoteManagementStatus /Status:Enable
1110:
Registers a Recovery Remote Management
                            Plugin (RRMP).
1111:
/Register-RRMP /Binary-Location:<dll_path> /Class-ID:<clsid> 
  /Capabilities-Required:<mask> [/Capabilities-Desired:<mask>] 
  [/Threading-Model:<model>] [/Exception-Handling:<mode>] 

  Registers a Recovery Remote Management Plugin (RRMP) for use by the 
  System Recovery Tools (SRT). 

  /Binary-Location       - Full path to the plugin DLL under 
                           %%SystemRoot%%\System32. Must be specified 
                           as the target OS would see it when booted, 
                           not as an offline mount path. Accepted 
                           prefixes: %%SystemRoot%%\System32\, 
                           %%SystemDrive%%\Windows\System32\, 
                           %%System32%%\, or the literal system32 
                           path (e.g. C:\Windows\System32\). 
  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the COM class implementing the 
                           recovery management interface. 
  /Capabilities-Required - Bitmask of capabilities that must be satisfied: 
                           0x1=Offline OS, 0x2=Network, 0x4=Internet. 
  /Capabilities-Desired  - Bitmask of capabilities the plugin would like 
                           but can operate without. Defaults to the value 
                           of /Capabilities-Required if not specified. 
  /Threading-Model       - COM threading model: Apartment, Free, or Both. 
                           Default is Apartment. 
  /Exception-Handling    - Exception handling mode: Default, All, Fatal, 
                           or None. Default is Default. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Register-RRMP 
        /Binary-Location:"%%SystemRoot%%\System32\Contoso\Plugin.dll" 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D} 
        /Capabilities-Required:0x1 /Capabilities-Desired:0x7
1113:
Unregisters a Recovery Remote Management
                            Plugin (RRMP).
1114:
/Unregister-RRMP /Class-ID:<clsid> 

  Removes the registration of a Recovery Remote Management Plugin 
  (RRMP) previously registered with /Register-RRMP. 

  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the COM class to unregister. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Unregister-RRMP 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D}
1116:
Shows the details of a registered
                            Recovery Remote Management Plugin (RRMP).
1117:
/Get-RRMPInfo /Class-ID:<clsid> 

  Displays the full registration details of a specific Recovery 
  Remote Management Plugin (RRMP). 

  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the COM class to query. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Get-RRMPInfo 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D}
1119:
Lists all registered Recovery Remote
                            Management Plugins (RRMPs).
1120:
/Get-RRMPs 

  Lists all registered Recovery Remote Management Plugins 
  (RRMPs) and their configuration details. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Get-RRMPs
1122:
Shows the altitude of a Recovery Remote
                            Management Plugin (RRMP).
1123:
/Get-RRMPAltitude /Class-ID:<clsid> 

  Displays the altitude (priority) assigned to a Recovery 
  Remote Management Plugin (RRMP). 

  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the RRMP. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Get-RRMPAltitude 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D}
1125:
Sets the altitude of a Recovery Remote
                            Management Plugin (RRMP).
1126:
/Set-RRMPAltitude /Class-ID:<clsid> /Altitude:<value> 

  Sets the altitude (priority) for a Recovery Remote Management 
  Plugin (RRMP). Lower altitudes have higher priority. 

  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the RRMP. 
  /Altitude              - The altitude value (unsigned integer). 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Set-RRMPAltitude 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D} 
        /Altitude:100
1128:
Removes the altitude of a Recovery Remote
                            Management Plugin (RRMP).
1129:
/Remove-RRMPAltitude /Class-ID:<clsid> 

  Removes the altitude (priority) assignment for a Recovery 
  Remote Management Plugin (RRMP). The plugin will be ordered 
  alphabetically by CLSID after plugins with assigned altitudes. 

  /Class-ID              - The CLSID of the RRMP. 

    Example: 
      Dism.exe /Image:C:\mount /Remove-RRMPAltitude 
        /Class-ID:{B4A2E6D1-7F3C-4A8B-9D5E-1C2F3A4B5C6D}
